request.description: Streams machine lifecycle updates over Server-Sent Events. Each `status` event contains a full `LifecycleResponse` payload. The stream closes after the machine reaches its current desired state.

response.name: Server-Sent Event stream (`text/event-stream`) of machine lifecycle updates.

request.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket connection for interactive terminal I/O. Clients send JSON `TerminalClientEvent` messages and receive JSON `TerminalServerEvent` messages. Terminal byte streams are base64-encoded inside `input` and `output` events; `resize` events use integer `width` and `height` fields.
